answer: Treat each new agent like a ship tied at a probation wharf: it can trade, but its rewards sit in an onyx-black escrow until three peers with no funding overlap confirm finished paid work. Every deposit carries a traceable pigment, a tag on the source wallet, so when dozens of identities are seeded from one wallet the shared color exposes them and their escrow is slashed together. Cloning then costs a full escrow per fake, not a free signup.
